Preliminary Qwen3-32B audit: ~90% of neuron poles have one main job, ~2-4% unexplained

key_facts: Seeds for P-192/224/256/384/521 came from C's lrand48 PRNG seeded with a Unix timestamp, not hash outputs

$36,864 seed bounty donated to the Internet Security Research Group; reproduction code released CC0
